scale.basis: Dimensions come from the callouts. The 100 axial length and the octagon flats are scaled from section B-B and the front view against the 170 cavity dimension.

frame: The main bore axis is Z. The rear face is z=0 and the front face is z=100. X is horizontal in the front view and Y points up toward the top boss. The origin is on the bore axis.
body: Octagonal housing extruded along Z over 0..100: X half-width 94, Y half-width 97, diagonal flats 107.6 from the axis
Front cavity Ø170 from z=100 down to z=55. A conical floor rises from Ø170 at z=55 to Ø84.3 at z=66
Rear cavity Ø170 from z=0 up to z=46. A conical roof runs from Ø84 at z=30 to Ø170 at z=46
Hub: Ø50 through. A Ø60 recess runs from z=54 to 66 at the front and from z=30 to 46.6 at the rear
Top boss Ø75 along +Y from y=89.5 to 117.5, centred at x=0, z=50, with six R7.5 lobes on a 37.5 radius

features.source: 7X Ø27.5 THRU on Ø130 at 36 deg pitch
Ø60 front recess in section B-B
Ø60 rear recess in section B-B
4X Ø10 UNTIL NEXT, 60 x 25 pattern, both sides

guessed: The octagon flats and the 100 axial length are scaled from the views.
The depth of the Ø65 boss bore and the 10 slot depth are estimated.
The 2X Ø10 tab holes, the flange lobes, the side tabs and the small fillets are omitted.
